description: Keep the simple 12x12 repeat-trip task fixed while reducing pheromone evaporation from 0.10 to 0.02, then repeat the fair three-seed full/no-pheromone check before Phase 2B.
selection_rule: No automatic winner. Candidate F can move to team review only when full-input PPO beats its same-seed separately trained no-pheromone PPO and random action on seeds 7, 17 and 27. This remains development work; Phase 2B does not start from a single seed.
required_reports: local pheromone-exposure diagnostic for the earlier Candidate E full policies
per-seed stochastic and deterministic food-delivery means
random-action reference on the same diagnostic maps
training/runtime provenance and every failed run
